class.name: OpenXRSpatialContainerExtension
class.brief_description: OpenXR extension that handles spatial containers.
class.description: OpenXR extension that handles spatial containers. Enabling this extension will automatically create a main spatial container, and update the lifecycle of the XR application.

method.name: get_spatial_container_bounds
method.description: Retrieves the bounds of the main spatial container.

method.name: get_spatial_container_state
method.description: Retrieves the [OpenXRSpatialContainerState] of the main spatial container.

method.name: get_supported_bounds_modes
method.description: Returns an array of supported spatial container bounds mode, see [enum OpenXRSpatialContainerState.BoundsMode].

method.name: is_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if spatial containers are enabled in the project settings and available on the current runtime.

method.name: is_spatial_container_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the main spatial container is active.

method.name: request_spatial_container_bounds_mode
method.description: Sends a request to the runtime to update the bounds mode of the main spatial container. If the request is accepted, [signal spatial_container_bounds_changed] will be emitted with the updated bounds mode. Otherwise, [signal spatial_container_bounds_mode_request_denied] will be emitted.

method.name: request_spatial_container_visible
method.description: Sends a request to the runtime to update the visibility of the spatial container. If the request is accepted, [signal spatial_container_visible_changed] will be emitted with the updated visibility. Otherwise, [signal spatial_container_visible_request_denied] will be emitted.

signal.name: spatial_container_bounds_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the bounds of the spatial container specified by [param spatial_container_rid] are updated.

signal.name: spatial_container_bounds_mode_request_denied
signal.description: Emitted when a request to update the bounds mode of the spatial container specified by [param spatial_container_rid] is denied by the runtime.

signal.name: spatial_container_closed
signal.description: Emitted when the spatial container specified by [param spatial_container_rid] is closed.

signal.name: spatial_container_interactable_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the interactability of the spatial container specified by [param spatial_container_rid] is updated.

signal.name: spatial_container_visible_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the visibility of the spatial container specified by [param spatial_container_rid] is updated.

signal.name: spatial_container_visible_request_denied
signal.description: Emitted when the runtime denies the visibility request of the spatial container specified by [param spatial_container_rid].
